title: Shovel
summary: Use to dig up buried treasure.

fields.Dig: Action, within 5 ft. Use the shovel from inventory. You can dig at the known position without passing the initial discovery check. One shovel suffices for the party. Wild Shape prevents digging.
fields.Acquisition: Common loot, including a dirt mound at X 204, Y 385, Whispering Depths and the Dank Crypt approach.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
